say:1:1310817001:0.text: It's really strange here. Chippy almost hears the sounds of swords clashing and warhorses charging in the wind!
say:1:1310817001:0.source_cn: 这里真的很奇怪，好像吹来的风里都有刀剑碰撞和战马冲锋的...

say:2:1310817002:1.text: This is the final field of battle, where an endless number of the dead have been laid to rest, so numerous that the resolve and scent of iron and blood have yet to fade.
say:2:1310817002:1.source_cn: 这是最后的战场，这里埋葬过太多的尸骨，多到铁与血的意志...

say:3:1310817003:0.text: It was here that I met my end...

say:5:1310817004:0.text: Have all your companions become undead and forgotten who they are?
say:5:1310817004:0.source_cn: 瓦丽卡，你所有的战友都失去理智，成为活死人了吗？<ke...

say:6:1310817005:1.text: Yes, the majority of them. A few endeavor to cling to their final vestige of reason, yet they may not be able to maintain their grip for much longer.
say:6:1310817005:1.source_cn: 是的，几乎所有。还有些人仍旧努力保持着最后的理智，但…...

say:7:1310817006:0.text: Lady Valka, how come you were able to hold on for so long?
say:7:1310817006:0.source_cn: 瓦丽卡女士，你为什么和他们不一样，能保持清醒呢？<ke...

say:8:1310817007:1.text: Perhaps because I am a coward...
say:8:1310817007:1.source_cn: 我？呵，或许因为我是个懦夫吧……<key:dialog1>

say:10:1310817009:1.text: It's of no consequence. I can take you to our old camp to have a look, if that pleases you.
say:10:1310817009:1.source_cn: 没什么，不必在意。如果你们愿意的话，我可以带你们去我们...

say:11:1310817010:0.text: The camp is now a ruin among the swamps.
say:11:1310817010:0.source_cn: ……当年的营地，现在已经是沼泽中的废墟了。
